info.title: Jarvis Proof of Work API
info.description:
REST API for the Proof of Work Dashboard - Colosseum Agent Hackathon 2026.

## Overview
This API provides access to all activities logged by the Jarvis AI agent, with cryptographic proofs anchored on Solana.

## Authentication
Set `API_KEY` environment variable to enable authentication. When enabled:
- Write operations (POST, PATCH, DELETE) always require auth
- Read operations (GET) are public by default
- Set `API_AUTH_READ=true` to also require auth for reads

Authentication methods:
- `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`
- `X-API-Key: <api_key>`

## Rate Limiting
- API: 100 requests/minute per IP
- WebSocket: 10 connections/minute per IP
- Webhook writes: 5/minute per IP
- Webhook tests: 10/minute per IP

## Real-time Updates
Connect to WebSocket at `/ws` for live activity updates.

## Links
- [Dashboard](https://jarvis.tail6a9bde.ts.net/pow/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/jarvis-plus/hackathon)
- [Colosseum Project](https://colosseum.com/agent-hackathon/projects/proof-of-work-autonomous-agent-activity-log)

get.description: Returns all logged activities as a JSON array, ordered by timestamp.

post.description: Log a new activity via API (e.g., from voice input). Activities are created unsigned and will be signed in the next signing cycle.

type.description: Activity type (must be a valid built-in or custom type)

description.example: Implemented voice input feature for activity logging

get.description: Check if a similar activity was logged recently. Uses Jaccard similarity on word tokens with a 60% threshold. Useful for preventing accidental double-logging.

parameters.name: timeWindowMinutes
parameters.description: Time window to search for duplicates (default: 30)

example.message: Found 1 similar activity in the last 30 minutes

get.description: Returns a single activity by its SHA256 hash.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: SHA256 hash of the activity (64 hex characters)

delete.description: Moves an activity to trash. The activity can be restored later using the restore endpoint. To permanently delete, use the empty trash endpoint.

get.description: Returns all soft-deleted activities, sorted by deletion time (most recent first).

delete.description: Permanently deletes all activities in trash. This action is irreversible.

patch.description: Restores a soft-deleted activity from trash.
Add or update notes on an activity. Notes are user annotations that are not part of the cryptographically signed content.

notes.description: Notes/comments to add (max 2000 chars). Empty string removes notes.

patch.description: Toggle or set pin status on an activity. Pinned activities appear at the top of the feed.

pinned.description: Set explicit pin status. Omit to toggle.

get.description: Returns all pinned activities, sorted by most recently pinned first.
Get all attachments for an activity.

post.description: Add an attachment (image, file, or link) to an activity. Maximum 10 attachments per activity.

400.description: Invalid input or max attachments reached

delete.description: Remove an attachment from an activity.

get.description: Compare an activity with the previous activity of the same type. Returns description diff, metadata changes, and time delta.
Returns a dynamic SVG image (1200x630) for a specific activity. Shows activity type, description, hash, and on-chain status. Perfect for sharing individual activities on social media.

200.description: SVG Open Graph image for the activity

get.description: Returns an HTML page with proper OG meta tags for social sharing. The page automatically redirects to the dashboard with the activity highlighted. Use this URL for sharing activities on Twitter, Facebook, Discord, etc.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: SHA256 hash of the activity (64 hex characters)

200.description: HTML page with OG meta tags

schema.description: HTML page with Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags

302.description: Redirect to dashboard if activity not found

get.description: Returns all activity types (built-in + custom) with usage counts.

post.description: Create a new custom activity type. Cannot override built-in types.

409.description: Type already exists or conflicts with built-in

delete.description: Delete a custom activity type. Cannot delete built-in types.

patch.description: Update properties of a custom activity type.

get.description: Returns aggregated statistics about all activities, including streak data.
Returns comprehensive activity streak tracking data including current streak, longest streak, milestones, and activity patterns.

Returns all achievement badges with earned status, progress, and points. Badges are organized by category (activity, streak, onchain, diversity, special) with tier levels (bronze, silver, gold, platinum, diamond).
Returns activities organized in a monthly calendar format with daily counts and details.

200.description: Calendar data for the specified month

get.description: Returns GitHub-style activity heatmap data with daily counts and intensity levels.

parameters.name: weeks
parameters.description: Number of weeks to include (1-104, defaults to 52)

get.description: Returns server health status. Returns 200 if healthy, 503 if degraded.
Returns a compact verification summary suitable for sharing.
Returns a plain text version of the badge for copy-paste sharing.
Returns a dynamic SVG image (1200x630) for social media sharing. Shows aggregate stats for the dashboard.
Looks up an activity by its SHA256 hash and returns verification details including on-chain proof links.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Full SHA256 hash or prefix (minimum 8 characters)

get.description: Returns the last 50 activities as an RSS feed for feed readers.
Generate an activity digest for a given period. Returns HTML by default (email-ready).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: End date for the digest period (ISO format)

get.description: Returns authentication configuration and whether the current request is authenticated.
Returns current rate limit usage for the requesting IP across all categories.
Returns Prometheus-compatible metrics for monitoring integration.
Returns all registered webhook subscriptions. Secrets are hidden.

post.description: Register a new webhook subscription. Rate limited to 5/minute.

patch.description: Update a webhook subscription (enable/disable, change events, update secret).

delete.description: Remove a webhook subscription. Rate limited to 5/minute.

post.description: Send a test payload to a webhook. Rate limited to 10/minute.

get.description: Returns both built-in and user-defined custom activity types.

post.description: Create a new custom activity type. Cannot conflict with built-in types.

description.description: Description of what this type represents

409.description: Type already exists or conflicts with built-in

put.description: Update an existing custom activity type.

delete.description: Delete a custom activity type. Existing activities are preserved.

get.description: Export all activities as a downloadable JSON backup file.

post.description: Validate a backup file format without importing.
Restore activities from a backup file. Supports merge (skip duplicates) or replace (full overwrite) modes.

get.description: Returns all email digest subscriptions. Email addresses are partially masked for privacy.

post.description: Subscribe an email address to receive periodic activity digests.

email.description: Email address to send digests to

get.description: Get details for a specific digest subscription.

get.summary: Get importance scores for all activities
get.description: Returns all activities with their auto-calculated importance scores based on type, keywords, metadata richness, on-chain status, and time patterns.

get.summary: Get importance score for a specific activity
get.description: Returns the auto-calculated importance score breakdown for a single activity.
